'''Null Town''' was a location in the [[South Pole (Centerpoint Station)|South Pole]] of the [[Centerpoint Station]] and was controlled by [[Baron/Legends|baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]], a businessman and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
